overview: Users & roles is in the left menu (company administrators); the Users page is headed 'User management'. It manages accounts, roles and market/department access. Counters show Total users, Active users, Company administrators and Assignments. The table lists Full name, Email, Role, Language, Markets, Departments and Status, with Edit per row and a Search box. Roles live on the sibling Roles page. Note: you can edit, lock or remove users here, but creating a brand-new user needs a password and is done in MCL, not through the assistant.

screenshots.alt: The User management page in the MCL web platform
screenshots.description: The MCL web User management page: counters for Total users, Active users, Company administrators and Assignments; a table of users with Full name, Email, Role, Language, Markets, Departments and Status, plus Edit; a Users/Roles submenu.

procedures.title: Change a user's role, markets or status

steps.text: On the Users page, find the person and click Edit on their row.
Change their role, markets, departments, language, or lock/unlock the account, then save.
